test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 31 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6 select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/109fefdcb4b84c0a258f0a29e831056d64d7abc808faae040db4b1102024748f.png]
solution:
Here, we can see that number 5 is common in both the dices. 

Also, we will write the numbers in clockwise direction starting from common number. 

1st dice: 5 - 4 - 6

2nd dice: 5 - 3 - 1

 

Thus, doing so, we will get number 6 which will be opposite to number 1.

 

Hence, the number __**6**__ will be on the face opposite to the one showing '1'.
